profile.address: 3835 N Freeway Blvd., Suite 250, Sacramento, CA 95834
profile.summary: Assist Programs is a Sacramento-based provider of school-day, before-school and after-school programs for students in transitional kindergarten through 8th grade. Its programs focus on active play, sports-based games, character education, social-emotional learning, and arts and science enrichment. It recruits and trains staff to run these programs at school sites, including expanded learning programs.

review.notes: ProPublica and GuideStar show 'Assist Academy', a Sacramento 501(c)(3) (EIN 83-4105309) at the same address and website as assistprograms.org, which offers before/after-school, ELOP and sports-based programs matching the agenda's Sacramento 'ASSIST Academy' expanded learning sports item. The About page does not name the legal entity or mention OUSD, so the entity link rests on name, address and website matches; the summary and contact fields are supported by the cited pages.
